text:
marco-peopleops: Heads-up — Lee's team has a cross-border promo: Tara is being moved from IC3 -> IC4 and is relocating to the UK office. Comp change includes base + GBP-denominated equity refresh. Need clarity on payroll routing and currency conversion for effective date Aug 1.

lee-manager: We want Aug 1 effective. Is the payroll cutoff different for international moves? Also do we submit one packet for relocation + promo or two separate requests?

tara-eng: FYI my current offer is USD, new comp should be shown in GBP for payroll. I also asked for an earlier vesting tranche as part of the refresh.

maria-payroll: Short answer: international comp changes need country addendum + localized payroll CSV. Cutoff for Aug 1 is Tue Jul 25 5pm PT for any comp that requires cross-border tax setup. If relocation requires payroll entity change, allow extra 5 business days.

marco-peopleops: Filing guidance: submit a standard comp-change CSV + attach "country-addendum-UK.pdf" and the signed manager approval. For equity refresh, include vesting schedule column and indicate currency. Example CSV header we prefer: `employee_id,employee_email,effective_date,base_currency,base_amount,bonus_amount,equity_currency,equity_amount,vesting_schedule,notes`

lee-manager: Do we need comp-committee sign-off for the equity refresh? It is a one-time £8k refresh (market adjustment + retention).

comp-committee-bot: Auto-check: equity refresh under £10k — requires people ops + manager approval only. If refresh or total grant exceeds £10k equivalent USD, committee review required.

oliver-legal: Quick legal note: relocation + payroll entity change requires signed UK employment addendum and confirmation of benefits enrollment options. Also share tax equalization intent if applicable. If any variable pay is guaranteed or has post-termination payouts, legal review needed.

lee-manager: Thanks — what's the retro window if we miss Jul 25 cutoff? Can we backdate to Aug 1 later?

maria-payroll: Retro adjustments can be processed up to 2 pay cycles after effective date for international moves, but note currency revaluation may affect tax withholding calculations and require a manual adjustment. Retro processing fee applies if payroll ops performs >3 manual edits per case.

marco-peopleops: To be explicit checklist: 1) Manager approval PDF with manager email + title, 2) canonical CSV with GBP amounts and headers as above, 3) signed UK addendum, 4) vesting/refresh schedule, 5) note if tax-equalization applies, 6) submit by Jul 25 5pm PT (or Jul 20 if entity change).

tara-eng: One more: my equity refresh includes an accelerated 3-month tranche — is that ok?

oliver-legal: Accelerated vesting is allowed but needs comp-committee oversight if the accelerated portion >£5k. Also confirm change doesn't conflict with original grant terms (check grant agreement).

lee-manager: We'll assemble docs today. Where do we upload?

marco-peopleops: Upload to the People Ops portal: https://redwood.infra/people-ops/change-submissions and tag `intl-promo`. Use single case per employee, but reference relocation under the same case note. If you have multiple related promos, link them in one parent case.

comp-committee-bot: Next committee meeting: Thu Jul 14 10am PT. If you need committee review, submit by Fri Jul 8 to be on the agenda.

maria-payroll: Reminder: for GB payroll we need bank details in IBAN format and employee tax ID. Also if employee is transferring from contractor->FT concurrently, headcount approval required before payroll can switch entity.

lee-manager: Noted. One operational Q: will the salary be paid in GBP or USD for the first partial pay period?

maria-payroll: If relocation effective mid-pay-period, payroll will pro-rate in the employee's old currency for days worked before relocation and new currency after. We convert using the day-of-payroll FX rate and record both amounts on the payslip. Expect small rounding diffs.

marco-peopleops: Anything else? If not, I'll mark this thread as guidance + checklist. Ping me directly if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:

lee-manager: Perfect thanks everyone — we'll submit by EOD tomorrow.

comp-committee-bot: Case created: #6148 by lee-manager. Status: pending docs.
